evals.prompt: Create a Member class with name always on, and an optional email attribute in a mixset Premium that is activated.
evals.expected_output: mixset Premium plus use Premium; Member has name and email when compiled.
expectations: The Umple source contains 'mixset Premium' or an equivalent mixset name
The Umple source contains 'use ' for that mixset
Member (or equivalent) has a name attribute outside the mixset
email (or equivalent) is inside the mixset
The API response does not contain umple-message-error

evals.prompt: Split Person into two mixin fragments (two class Person blocks) in the same model and compile.
evals.expected_output: Two class Person { } blocks that merge.
expectations: The Umple source contains 'class Person' more than once, or is saved as more than one .ump file that mix in Person
The API response does not contain umple-message-error
